text:
marie_k: Quick design check on the Compliance panel from today's QA. Two things jumped out: the "Region" label is being used in a few places but sometimes we mean data residency vs environment. Also the small KMS chip in the audit row is hard to read on hover. Can we align on copy + behavior?

sam_g: Noted. For copy we should be explicit: if the control scopes retention to a geographic location use `Data residency (region)`; if it scopes to infra environment use `Environment`. Which are we trying to show here?

marie_k: It's actually per-region (data residency). The UI mixes both in places which is why people get confused. Prefer `Data residency` in the modal header and `Region` in the selector dropdown label.

toni_l: Implementation catch: current save flow does optimistic close. Sequence: user changes retention -> modal closes immediately -> global state rehydrates -> selector snaps to account default for a brief moment -> toast appears. That snap looks like we saved to the wrong region. Options: (a) disable close until save confirmed, (b) keep modal open until state stable, (c) include region in the toast. I can do (c) fast.

sam_g: I like (c) as a minimal fix: toast text `Saved retention — us-west (30 days)`. But we should follow up with a UX change that prevents the confusing flicker.

nora_h: Accessibility: toasts need `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"` and keyboard focusable action (e.g., `View`) so screen reader users get context. Also KMS chip must have `aria-label` that expands the terse text, e.g., `Customer-managed key (KMS)` so NVDA reads full meaning.

raj_p: Backend rename proposal: we're currently emitting `kms_owner: "user"|"platform"` in audit events. Let's standardize to `kms_type: "customer_managed"|"platform_managed"` and add `kms_description` for human text if needed. Front-end can fall back to old `kms_owner` if new field missing.

marie_k: Sounds good. We should avoid the phrase `encrypted: customer` in any user-visible copy. That's ambiguous.

sam_g: Agreed. For the audit row visible string I propose `Customer-managed KMS` (short) and a tooltip: `Encrypted with a key you control (customer-managed KMS).` For platform keys: `Platform-managed KMS` with tooltip `Encrypted with Redwood-managed keys.`

toni_l: Plan for FE: (1) show region in toast, (2) increase toast duration to 7s when verbose, (3) add focusable `View` link on toast, (4) render `kms_type` when present and fallback to existing fields. I'll open a PR.

nora_h: Also: KMS chip color on hover fails contrast AA for both text and the hover background. We need +4.5:1 for body text. I'll attach a quick token suggestion in the PR: use `--color-text-on-accent: #0b2540` on hover.

raj_p: I'll change the audit payload today and ship a minor API bump. New field is additive; old clients keep working. Event schema change will be in `audit-service v3.0.0` release.

marie_k: Great. Can we also change the modal help copy? Current: `Choose retention window` -> new: `Retention window for selected data residency. Controls how long generated artifacts are stored.`

sam_g: That reads well. Also add `aria-describedby` from the radio group to the help copy.

toni_l: Noted. I'll wire `aria-describedby` + update copy in the same PR as the toast changes.

marie_k: Action list: Raj (audit payload + deploy), Toni (FE PR: toast + fallback + aria + copy), Nora (a11y review on PR), Sam (final copy sign-off). I'll QA after deploy. Thanks all :sparkles:

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: audit-service v3.0.0 -> production 19:10 UTC (raj_p).
